title: Normalize a tensor right adjunction at the coefficient unit
statement: Let C and D be categories, with D monoidal. Let P:C->D be a functor and H:D->D a fully faithful functor. Let I be an object of C, L and M objects of D, and u:P(I)≅1_D. Put G=(P followed by tensorRight(L)) followed by H. Let F:D->C and R:C->D be functors and let a:F⊣G and b:F⊣R be adjunctions. Given isomorphisms q:G(I)≅M and z:M≅R(I), there exists an adjunction adj:F⊣G such that the inverse of the composite of the counit-compatible right-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism b.rightAdjointUniq(adj) at I with q equals z.hom. The right-adjoint uniqueness comparison is the specified one of [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint].

source.place: Local construction, affine-space adjunction and the coefficient orientation: categorical normalization used in parent proof Step 1.

proof.text: Let v:P(I) tensor L≅L be tensorRight(L).mapIso(u) followed by the left unitor, and let w=H.mapIso(v). For an automorphism k of G(I), full faithfulness of H gives a unique automorphism e of L whose image is w inverse followed by k followed by w. Tensoring on the right by e, and whiskering by P and H, gives a natural automorphism h of G. Naturality of the left unitor and the tensor exchange law show h(I)=k. This is the proved private lift_tensor_auto lemma.

Let e0 be the component at I of b.rightAdjointUniq(a) followed by q, using [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint]. Apply the first step to k=q followed by z followed by e0 followed by q inverse. Transport a across h inverse to obtain adj. The hom-equivalence formula for a transported adjunction and the formula for rightAdjointUniq imply b.rightAdjointUniq(adj).hom=b.rightAdjointUniq(a).hom followed by h inverse. Substitute h(I)=k, cancel q and the uniqueness component, and obtain that the new uniqueness component followed by q followed by z is identity. Cancellation of the isomorphism component followed by q identifies its inverse with z.hom. All helpers and the combining calculation are proved.
